candidate.name: intraday_intrabar_body_magnitude_serial_persistence_238p
candidate.formula: let b_i=abs(log(close_i/open_i)) on the 240 continuous-session bars; pool the 119 adjacent (b_t,b_t+1) pairs from each half and return their population Pearson correlation
candidate.source_grid: validate the exact 241-row Tushare grid, then use exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00; exclude 09:30 and the lunch transition
candidate.support: all 240 opens and closes finite and strictly positive; both fixed 238-element lag and lead body-magnitude vectors have strictly positive population variance
candidate.zero_semantics: exact-zero bodies remain in fixed support and are never dropped or bridged

nearest_mechanism_distinctions.name: intraday_absolute_return_serial_persistence_236p
nearest_mechanism_distinctions.distinction: It correlates adjacent absolute close-to-close returns. Campaign109 correlates same-bar absolute open-to-close bodies, excluding interbar gaps from both operands; the two are not monotone transforms of one another.

nearest_mechanism_distinctions.name: intraday_intrabar_body_range_efficiency_240m
nearest_mechanism_distinctions.distinction: It is an order-invariant ratio of total absolute body mass to total high-low range mass. Campaign109 reads no high/low and measures adjacent dependence rather than aggregate body size.

nearest_mechanism_distinctions.name: intraday_bar_direction_continuity_238p
nearest_mechanism_distinctions.distinction: It discards body magnitude and counts same-sign body pairs. Campaign109 discards body sign and retains magnitude dependence.

nearest_mechanism_distinctions.name: intraday_interbar_gap_body_confirmation_238p and intraday_body_next_microgap_reversal_238p
nearest_mechanism_distinctions.distinction: Those mechanisms relate signed bodies to interbar gaps. Campaign109 contains no prior-close/current-open boundary and no signed relation.

nearest_mechanism_distinctions.name: intraday_intrabar_close_location_serial_persistence_238p
nearest_mechanism_distinctions.distinction: It tracks close position inside each high-low interval. Campaign109 reads neither high nor low and tracks absolute open-close displacement.

nearest_mechanism_distinctions.name: intraday_directional_range_response_coupling_238p
nearest_mechanism_distinctions.distinction: It correlates a signed body with the next bar's high-low range. Campaign109 correlates direction-neutral body magnitude with the next body magnitude.

nearest_mechanism_distinctions.name: intraday_continuous_session_net_return_reversal_240m and intraday_signed_path_efficiency_239m
nearest_mechanism_distinctions.distinction: They measure endpoint or signed path displacement. Campaign109 is invariant to body sign and endpoint net displacement and uses only adjacent body magnitudes.

support_review.reason_zero_body_failure_not_inherited: Campaign019 required at least 120 informative nonzero sign pairs; Campaign109 retains every zero body and requires only nondegenerate magnitude variance.
